headline: Canalside city living moments from Piccadilly
description: A prime residential development comprising 72 contemporary one- and two-bedroom apartments in a coveted canalside setting on Store Street. Benefiting from a 24/7 concierge and superior architectural finishes, the building sits just three minutes from Piccadilly Station, placing Manchester's financial core, the Northern Quarter and Ancoats within effortless reach. Typical rental yields in this market range from 5-8%, offering strong potential for long-term investors.
